t: COM in .NET
s: COM (Component Object Model) in .NET facilitates interoperability between .NET and COM objects. Using COM Callable Wrappers (CCW) and Runtime Callable Wrappers (RCW), .NET code can access COM components, enabling seamless integration of legacy COM components with .NET applications.
